shared_elements: incised relief on a rounded/blocky stone surface
hatched or net-like geometric pattern of parallel and crossing lines
justification: The only real correspondence is a schematic incised grid/hatched pattern — A has a horizontal band of net-like hatching across the pillar, while B's whole surface is covered by a crossing-line net over a rounded head-like mass, and both may involve a schematic animal head. Otherwise A is a densely populated multi-register composition of profile birds, quadrupeds, a scorpion-like creature and other creatures in fixed vertical order, whereas B depicts a single isolated three-dimensional lump with no figural scene, no registers and no interacting figures.
